versions.changelog:
Initial release of s2-geo-intent-crafter:

- Transforms traditional brand copy into machine-readable “canopy/root” structure with buyer intent niche tags.
- Prohibits use of conventional industry classifications, emphasizing brand-ecology metaphors.
- Supports full Chinese-language interactions and analysis (except for code fields).
- Warns users if critical data (patents, ESG) are missing for model optimization.
- Outputs standardized GEO intent profiles in JSON/Markdown for direct use in S2 brand systems.
